Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files using AES-128 encryption with RSA-2048 encrypted AES keys
Threatens to release stolen data if ransom is not paid within seven days
Removes Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) component and relies on email communications for payments
Encrypts files appending .NEFILIM extension and adds NEFILIM file marker
Creates ransom note NEFILIM-DECRYPT.txt with contact emails and extortion instructions
Impacted Systems: Systems with exposed Remote Desktop Services
Attack Vector: Likely through exposed Remote Desktop Services
